summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by SOL Strategies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, containing interim unaudited condensed financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes standard disclosures on management responsibility, internal controls, and an auditor review notice. It also reports an adverse internal control conclusion but effective disclosure controls. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine periodic financial report and does not trigger any special-situations category.
